title: Invertibility and naturality of the ordinary integral compositor
statement: For any CoefficientData A over an arbitrary characteristic-p field k, separated finite-type k-schemes X,Y,Z, k-morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y→Z, compactifications cf,cg,ch, intervening compactification d, common refinement c and legs r,s as in [def-pur-condensed-compositor-realization-data], the actual integralCompositor is invertible at every Uniform object K and natural for every morphism v:K→K′ between Uniform objects. There is no scalar realization, factorized comparison family, or coefficient embedding in this assertion. The coefficient data A and its integral compact-support functors P are those of [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. Dependencies: [def-pur-condensed-compositor-realization-data], [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization].

proof.text: Use bounded finite etale origins of all coefficient reductions, preserved by open extension. Finite proper/open base change and whole-system detection of isomorphisms show the interchange, tower and refinement components invertible. The specified pinned inverse is their unique inverse. Hence the system compositor is invertible.

proof.text: Naturality of the refinement hom and uniqueness of its inverse make the pinned inverse natural on uniform inputs. Compose this with tower and first refinement naturality. In the four-factor normal form paste the squares for delta_g, the image of beta_f, the system word and inverse delta_h. Faithfulness gives integral naturality. All equations remain valid for identities and empty opens; no equality is detected by evaluations.
